scenarios.claim: Two successive production compactions with changed AGENTS.md refresh instructions, publish live and history rows with distinct windows and epoch+1, and replay byte-identically after restart.
An interrupt observed after the descriptor commits cannot report the durable compaction as interrupted; an unpublished one is the interruption.
A summary that does not reduce context is refused before publication and the previous descriptor stays in effect.
The shipped CLI creates and works a Session, the product is killed mid-attempt, and after restart attach --resume and a resumed run preserve identity with exactly one process-loss terminal.
A well-formed cursor naming no message in the Session refuses instead of returning an empty page.
Wrong project, wrong service root, stale cursor, a newer engine migration and a corrupt store each refuse actionably without mutating the store.
After a child is lost with its runtime, a successor child completes under the new generation and delivers to the same parent with lineage intact.
The lost child settles once as process loss, is never replayed, and its stale Session refuses late prompts so no escaped delivery settles the parent.
A scoped parent interrupt cancels its running child without recording an answer (landed witness consumed).
A session interrupt reaches a running plugin tool and settles a cancelled durable terminal (landed witness consumed).

A Git-backed checkpoint pins its exact commit, survives restart through interrupted-restore recovery, refuses a restore after HEAD moves without moving Git, and refuses an unsupported provider and a corrupt journal.
An unborn Git root refuses capture instead of pinning a missing baseline.
One disposable headless product root: CLI create, compaction, a subagent lost with the process, restart, CLI attach --resume and a resumed run whose successor child delivers.
Every durable live event of a deterministic run announces its own committed fact, so the shipped CLI converges instead of refusing a repeated sequence.

deferrals.reason: No ratified public StateEngine checkpoint/resume contract exists; amendment section 5 stays DEFER-LEAF with rich checkpoint UI.
The product composes only foreground subagents; grapt-subagent background claim/deliver has no product caller, so background delivery is not claimed.
The product checkpoint boundary is exercised directly; no Session-level checkpoint API exists and none is invented.
Compaction failure remains a typed Step failure; the Rust event model has no session.compaction.failed fact and this campaign does not own grapt-event.
